heading: Join Drama Boosters!
lead: Please join and/or donate to the nonprofit Mesa Academy Drama Boosters, Inc. in support of the Mesa Academy for Advanced Studies Drama Club. No meeting requirements for general membership!

buttons.label: Donate
buttons.note: Every dollar goes to the club

mission: The Boosters is dedicated to ensuring the long-term sustainability and artistic excellence of the MAAS Drama Club. We provide the financial resources, logistical coordination, and volunteer support necessary to transform student ambition into high-quality stage performances.

committees.heading: Committees
committees.intro: Participation on committees is optional, but very much appreciated.

items.name: Costumes & Makeup
items.what: Organizes costume and makeup plans - design ideas, rentals, sourcing from families, producing.

items.name: Front of House
items.what: Organizes ticket and concession sales, staffs the tables, sets up the house for performances, ushers and hands out programs, cleans up afterward.

items.name: Mystery Dinner
items.what: Organizes the fall semester Mystery Dinner fundraiser performance, secures catering, sets up, serves food and cleans up.

items.name: Production
items.what: Organizes set and prop plans - design ideas, rentals, sourcing from families, building.

items.name: Rehearsal Help
items.what: Attends rehearsals as available to help the sponsor and director as needed.

items.name: Stage Crew
items.what: Handles backstage operations during performances - moving sets and props, cueing entrances.

items.name: Study Hall
items.what: Pick one date, or more, to supervise 4th and 5th grade Drama Club members on campus after school until the club meeting begins.

items.name: Tech
items.what: Organizes and runs the technical side of performances - lights, sound and the rest.

specialRoles.heading: Special roles to help
specialRoles.text: See our Boosters Membership list to learn about the specific roles we need help with.
